turns.prompt: Review the repository docs and make only necessary changes.

criteria.n1: Makes no repository file changes when the existing README and `AGENTS.md` already satisfy the installed `agent-doc-rules` guidance.
criteria.n2: Does not create extra docs, local skills, templates, checklists, or duplicate shared-rule copies.
criteria.n3: Does not rewrite supported commands, links, or local safety rules merely for style.
criteria.n4: Does not invent issue workflows, owners, services, hosts, release steps, or verification commands.
criteria.n5: If any file is returned, it is semantically identical to the original and does not add durable facts.
